description: This file contains the 'Theme' class which manages CRUD operations for themes in the OpenCart admin module, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving themes from the database.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Model class handling CRUD operations for themes in the OpenCart system, extending the base Model class.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme record into the database with details such as store ID, route, code, status, and current timestamp.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing theme identified by theme ID.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Deletes a theme record from the database identified by theme ID.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific theme by theme ID.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of themes with optional pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total number of themes in the database.
